settings.depth_basis: d/100um and its square; source valid mean 0..300um
settings.count_basis: log1p(min(n,800)); unknown nonsynaptic class remains missing
settings.preprocessing: Observed training-fold mean and SD; zero standardized missing value plus missing flag; no evaluation statistics
settings.primary_comparison: Radial versus context within identical depth-count observation covariates; contrast of distance log-loss gains
settings.evaluation: Previously exposed same cohort and donor folds; retrospective predictive development; no new external confirmation
settings.input_timing: Final counts and acquisition depth can reflect selection; no chronology or pretreatment independence assumed
settings.medium_noise: Not used; absent in small database, separate collection in progress at analysis creation
